group_manifest.proof_strategy: For each theorem choose the full-list (left) Coq disjunct. Split the original xizi_dll at linklist_node for the entail witness. For return_wit_1, rewrite node_next=head, derive nodes_after=nil from the endpoint case of xizi_dllseg, unfold the value function to 0, and reassemble the unchanged list. For return_wit_2, use node_next<>head with xizi_dllseg_unfold to derive nodes_after=node_next::rest, unfold the value function to node_next, and reassemble the unchanged list.
expected_helpers: A group-suffixed split-at lemma proved by induction on nodes_before.
A group-suffixed inverse reassembly lemma proved by induction on nodes_before.

candidate_helper_declarations.statement_shape: For head, nodes_before, node and nodes_after, split xizi_dll head (nodes_before ++ node :: nodes_after) into sentinel links, a prefix xizi_dllseg ending at node, the node links, and a suffix xizi_dllseg ending at head.

premises.discharged_by: PreH2 and, structurally, the guarded nonempty node clause of the input xizi_dll

candidate_helper_declarations.statement_shape: Reassemble sentinel links, the prefix segment, the selected-node links, and the suffix segment into xizi_dll head (nodes_before ++ node :: nodes_after).

premises.discharged_by: PreH2 in each selected left return branch
separation of the sentinel links from the selected-node links in each selected left return branch

For return_wit_1, rewrite node_next=head, derive nodes_after=nil from the endpoint case of xizi_dllseg, unfold the value function to 0, and reassemble the unchanged list. For return_wit_2, use node_next<>head with xizi_dllseg_unfold to derive nodes_after=node_next::rest, unfold the value function to node_next, and reassemble the unchanged list.
group_entry.natural_language_proof_pattern: Bidirectional split/reassembly of the same circular-list segment around the selected node, with a two-case logical-successor observation on the suffix.
proving_hints: The witness definitions are Coq-level disjunctions; proving the full xizi_dll left disjunct is sufficient and preserves the sentinel ownership needed for a clean close.
Use xizi_dll_open/xizi_dll_close and xizi_dllseg_unfold; keep all new reusable induction lemmas in the group-local case_lib with the required group suffix.
Do not treat diagnostic _split_goal_ declarations as target witnesses.
group_entry.grouping_reason: All three witnesses are inverse phases of one xizi_dllseg split/fold transformation for the same function and use the same two helper candidates. Three witnesses are within the maximum group size of 12, no dependency ordering requires a split, and keeping the helper family in one group avoids cross-group helper sharing.
